summary: The manuscript presents NULLCONE-QG-CERT-1.0, an exemplary machine-checked arithmetic kernel and zero-float rational certificate suite auditing Chandrasekaran's null-cone quantization of four-dimensional vacuum general relativity. It features an 18-theorem constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel without any axioms or choices, alongside an AST-audited Python verifier covering 16 canonical JSON certificates across graviton pair creation, causal diamond finiteness, marginally trapped surfaces and Sen's 1-loop entropy, and AdS thermal traces/spatial topology null states. All 38 forgery-rejection tests pass successfully. The refereeing assessment confirms impeccable rigor, complete reproducibility, and profound foundational significance.
